track.title: Homayoun: Bidad, Shebh-e Zarbi Bidad
track.notes: Tagged title: Bidad, Shebhe Zarbi Bidad. A different performance from the Homayoun suites of 'Lord of Setar' and 'Setar' (no onset alignment).

just_intervals.note: measured octave minus 1200 ¢, register to register

progression.narrative: The performance opens on A3 and dwells most on C in Bidad. Shebh-e Zarbi Bidad (0:42.3) introduces Gk, A, Bb, centred on C. The line peaks at F4 (343.0 Hz) at 0:31.6. It closes on Db4, not the tonic (Gk3 → Gk3 → C4 → C4 → C4 → Db4).

flags: tonic F set in the catalog (Homayoun's finalis F, about 171 Hz (the daramad, its continuation and Mansuri-Zanguleh-Forud end there, and every track's pitch set fits Homayoun from it). The vote picked the 4th above, which is the ist in Bidad (Farhat 1990, p. 70). Inference, not yet by ear); the runs' vote favoured 227.3 Hz (A)
